title: Top High Converting Facebook Ad Examples for Contractors

facts.fact: The average Facebook lead campaign cost per lead (CPL) hit $27.66 in 2025, a 21% year-over-year increase, according to PPC Land's cross-vertical lead campaign analysis.
facts.quote: The average Facebook lead campaign CPL hit $27.66 in 2025, a 21% year-over-year jump

facts.fact: Google's lead campaign average cost per lead is $70.11, according to the page, which says Facebook's $27.66 CPL is 60% cheaper.
facts.quote: That’s still 60% cheaper than Google’s $70.11 lead campaign average.

facts.fact: The all-industry Facebook conversion rate in 2025 was 8.95%, per the page.
facts.quote: The all-industry Facebook conversion rate in 2025 was **8.95%**

facts.fact: Facebook lead campaigns averaged a 7.72% conversion rate in 2025, per the page.
facts.quote: with lead campaigns averaging 7.72%

facts.fact: Per WordStream's 2025 benchmark report, a Facebook ad has about three seconds to stop the scroll before the algorithm deprioritizes it.
facts.quote: You have three seconds to stop the scroll before the algorithm deprioritizes the ad, per WordStream’s 2025 benchmark report.

facts.fact: Per LeadsBridge's 2025 case data, lead form ads convert 25-35% higher than landing page ads for home service contractors.
facts.quote: Lead form ads convert 25-35% higher than landing page ads

facts.fact: In Mammoth for Plumbers' 2025 case study, a Dallas plumber generated $76,608 from $1,500 in Facebook spend.
facts.quote: A Dallas plumber running this exact structure generated $76,608 from $1,500 in Facebook spend

facts.fact: In the same Mammoth for Plumbers 2025 case study, the campaign produced 112 inbound calls at a $684 average ticket and 51x ROAS.
facts.quote: 112 inbound calls at a $684 average ticket, 51x ROAS

facts.fact: According to Service Finance Company's 2025 survey, 78% of homeowners say payment options influence their contractor choice.
facts.quote: 78% of homeowners say payment options influence their contractor choice

facts.fact: One roofing operator on r/sweatystartup reported 412 inspection requests in 11 days at a $4.20 cost per lead during a Texas hailstorm, versus a normal CPL of $38.
facts.quote: generated **412 inspection requests in 11 days at a $4.20 cost per lead** - normal CPL was $38

facts.fact: A lawn care operator quoted in HVAC Marketing Xperts' 2026 breakdown reported a 22% booking rate on this ad structure.
facts.quote: reported **22% booking rates on this structure**

facts.fact: Per Simply Be Found's 2025 lead cost report, electrical Facebook ads pull a CPL of $35-$70, with strong performance on panel upgrades.
facts.quote: Electrical Facebook ads pull a CPL of $35-$70 with strong performance on panel upgrades

facts.fact: Per SearchLight Digital's analysis of $2.3M in spend across 262 contractors, top-quartile HVAC and plumbing Facebook advertisers hit 5.17x ROAS or higher, while the spend-weighted median is 1.65x.
facts.quote: Top-quartile HVAC and plumbing advertisers on Facebook hit 5.17x ROAS or higher

facts.fact: A garage door operator on r/FacebookAds reported a $12 cost per call with a 68% answer rate for this ad pattern, versus $42 CPL on lead forms for the same business.
facts.quote: A garage door operator on r/FacebookAds reported this pattern hit a **$12 cost per call with a 68% answer rate**, vs $42 CPL on lead forms for the same business.

facts.fact: Hook Agency's 2025 playbook recommends geographic radius set to the actual service area plus a small buffer, homeowner targeting on, age 30+, and excluding renters.
facts.quote: **Geographic radius set to your actual service area plus a small buffer, homeowner targeting on, age 30+, exclude renters**, per Hook Agency’s 2025 playbook.

facts.fact: The page states that retargeting audiences who visited service pages convert 3-5x better than cold audiences.
facts.quote: Retargeting audiences who hit your service pages convert 3-5x better than cold.

facts.fact: Foreplay's 2025 analysis of 13 high-converting Facebook ad examples found action verbs matching the offer's friction level beat generic "Learn More" by 40-60%.
facts.quote: Foreplay’s 2025 analysis of 13 high-converting Facebook ad examples found **action verbs that match the offer’s friction level beat generic “Learn More” by 40-60%**.

facts.fact: LocaliQ's 2025 home services search benchmark showed campaigns converting at 7.33% on search.
facts.quote: LocaliQ’s 2025 home services search benchmark showed campaigns converting at 7.33% on search.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2025 benchmark report puts the all-industry average Facebook ad conversion rate at 8.95%.
facts.quote: The all-industry average is 8.95% per WordStream’s 2025 benchmark report, with lead campaigns specifically averaging 7.72%.

facts.fact: The page states home services contractors with seasonal offers and tight targeting routinely hit 12-15% conversion on lead form ads.
facts.quote: Home services contractors with seasonal offers and tight targeting routinely hit 12-15% on lead form ads.

facts.fact: For service call campaigns (tune-ups, repairs, drain cleans), the page recommends a monthly budget of $500 to $1,500.
facts.quote: For service call campaigns - tune-ups, repairs, drain cleans - budget $500 to $1,500 per month.

facts.fact: For install and replacement campaigns, the page recommends a monthly budget of $1,500 to $5,000.
facts.quote: For install and replacement campaigns budget $1,500 to $5,000 per month.

facts.fact: The page states that anything under $500 per month does not give Facebook's algorithm enough data to optimize.
facts.quote: Anything under $500/month does not give Facebook’s algorithm enough data to optimize.

facts.fact: The page states leads contacted within five minutes book at two to three times the rate of leads contacted an hour later.
facts.unit: x booking rate vs leads contacted an hour later
facts.quote: Leads contacted within five minutes book at two to three times the rate of leads contacted an hour later.

facts.fact: The page states lead forms convert 25-35% higher on volume than landing pages but produce lower-intent leads.
facts.quote: Lead forms convert 25-35% higher on volume but produce lower-intent leads.

facts.fact: Facebook CPC averages $1.88 for lead campaigns, according to the page.
facts.quote: Facebook CPC averages $1.88 for lead campaigns, and CPL averages $27.66 cross-industry, $35-$55 for HVAC and plumbing per HVAC Webmasters’ 2025 data.

facts.fact: Facebook CPL averages $27.66 cross-industry, per the page.
facts.quote: CPL averages $27.66 cross-industry, $35-$55 for HVAC and plumbing per HVAC Webmasters’ 2025 data.
